title: San Antonio Here We Come! 2023 UTA Annual Conference
description: Join us at North America's premier event for used-truck professionals — the UTA Annual Convention in San Antonio.

props.text: Events · 1 min read · By Jerry Van Galder
North America's premier event for used-truck professionals — find us in booth 413.

November 8–11, San Antonio, Texas. Join us at North America's premier event for used truck professionals! The UTA Annual Convention, anchored by the Used Truck Association and leading industry collaborators, promises an unmatched experience. Here's what's revving up:

items.label: Voices of the industry — speakers who drive the industry forward
Texas-sized celebrations and culinary pit stops
San Antonio vibes — a city where history meets horsepower

props.text: Embrace the momentum of this year's convention, where the spirit of Texas meets the pulse of the used-truck industry. We'll be in booth 413 — stop by and say howdy!
